nodes.label: HACS zip_release content_in_root Convention
nodes.rationale: HACS's zip_release download mode with content_in_root:false extracts the release archive straight into the plugin's own folder, so the zip's contents must sit at the top level (built from inside public/) rather than under a public/ wrapper directory.

nodes.label: Test workflow (GitHub Actions)
nodes.rationale: No npm, no dependencies: tests load the shipped public/*.js directly.

nodes.label: House consumption, derived automatically
nodes.rationale: Removes the last manual setup step (a template sensor). consumption = production + gridImport - gridExport + batteryDischarge - batteryCharge; explicit sensor always wins; any input missing shows '—' rather than a partial sum; derived values are labelled 'calculated'.

nodes.label: No internet access needed to run
nodes.rationale: React, fonts and hls.js ship in public/vendor/ so a local-only Home Assistant draws the dashboard as designed.
nodes.norm_label: no internet access needed to run

nodes.label: Manual installation
nodes.rationale: The casa/casa2 side-by-side pattern is manual-only; carrying it to HACS is the most common cause of a name: mismatch.

nodes.label: module_url ?v= cache-busting
nodes.rationale: /local/ is served with long cache headers and ES modules are cached aggressively, so a hard refresh does not reliably refetch panel.js.

nodes.label: Settings panel layered over config.js
nodes.rationale: config.js resolves roles; the panel only decides visibility, with a 'differs from config.js' pill.

nodes.label: Enabling Energy (role-based sensor mapping)
nodes.rationale: Sensors are asked for by role, not brand, so any integration works.

nodes.label: Enabling Irrigation (valve vs buttons)
nodes.rationale: Agronomic math (ET0/ETc, deficit) is deliberately out of scope: it depends on the user's own station and soil data.

nodes.label: Vehicle (optional)

nodes.label: window.CasaCore namespace
nodes.rationale: Global namespace export (base, DEFAULT_CONFIG, mergeConfig, ASSET_V, bust, loadScript, switchScenario, CONFIG_PATHS, loadUserConfig) instead of module exports, for file:// demo mode.

nodes.label: CasaComponentBase
nodes.rationale: Shared component class built once on top of the runtime's DCLogic and reused; pages extend it and keep only their template, initial state and renderVals(). Instance fields (cfg, registries, strings Proxy, _actionLog, _irrigationClosing) give safe synchronous defaults for the first render before _boot() resolves.

nodes.label: DEFAULT_CONFIG
nodes.rationale: Defaults mirror live_dashboard_config.example.js; a missing/broken config.js degrades to this, never to a crash.

nodes.label: ASSET_V
nodes.rationale: Reuses panel.js's ?v= VERSION so one bump busts the whole script chain, not only this file.

nodes.label: CONFIG_PATHS
nodes.rationale: Config lookup order; /local/live_dashboard_config.js first because HACS overwrites its own folder on update. /local/ candidates only tried inside the HA iframe to avoid pointless 404s.

nodes.label: componentDidMount()
nodes.rationale: 15s tick drives clock, hourly-energy refetch on hour change and irrigation auto-close; visibilitychange suspends snapshot/fast-poll timers when hidden.

nodes.label: _startSnapTimer()
nodes.rationale: Cache-busts camera preview on a timer; suspended while the page is hidden so the wall tablet doesn't fetch in the background.

nodes.label: _openCam()
nodes.rationale: Opens camera detail with a 120s auto-close and starts the layered stream.

nodes.label: _closeCam()
nodes.rationale: Bumps camStreamReqId so a slow in-flight stream response for a closed camera cannot land afterwards.

nodes.label: _camStartStream()
nodes.rationale: Layered live view: hls.js first wherever Media Source exists, native HLS only where hls.js can't run (Chrome's native HLS can't parse HA fMP4/HEVC), fast camera_proxy stills as last resort. Never shows an error, always degrades to something moving.

nodes.label: _camVideoRef()
nodes.rationale: One stable ref callback per (layer,url): a fresh arrow each render restarted the media load (14 reloads in 10s measured). Also forces muted since React doesn't reliably reflect the attribute.

nodes.label: _camLayerFailed()
nodes.rationale: A chosen layer failing at playback steps down hls.js -> native HLS -> fast stills instead of leaving a black box; recorded in Diagnostica.

nodes.label: _setCamDiag()
nodes.rationale: camDiag is an instance field, not state; read by the Diagnostica camera rows.

nodes.label: _ensureHlsJs()
nodes.rationale: Lazily loads vendored hls.js once per session, only when a camera detail opens on a Media Source browser.

nodes.label: _attachHlsJs()
nodes.rationale: MSE playback needs a live HTMLVideoElement; fatal hls.js errors route to _camLayerFailed.

nodes.label: _camStartFastPoll()
nodes.rationale: Tier-3 fallback: load-chained camera_proxy stills, preloaded off-screen so the frame is swapped not blanked; a fixed 400ms timer starved slow cameras (8.5s per still).

nodes.label: _camStopFastPoll()
nodes.rationale: Generation counter invalidates pending still loads.

nodes.label: _boot()
nodes.rationale: Loads discovery/prefs/i18n/backend scripts, user config, connects backend, then assigns cfg/registries/strings/t synchronously together so an interleaved state push never renders with half-booted fields.

nodes.label: _loadIrrigationEnds()
nodes.rationale: Loads persisted valve deadlines and checks them immediately so an overdue valve closes on the next dashboard that opens.

nodes.label: _loadHourlyEnergy()
nodes.rationale: Fetches hourly statistics for the same ids _resolveEnergyDaily resolved; only on view open and hour change. undefined (not loaded) is distinct from null (no statistics).

nodes.label: _resolveEnergyDaily()
nodes.rationale: Fills production/grid-import/grid-export today totals not set in config: HA Energy prefs first, then auto-discovery; sums multiple ids; captures diag data for the Diagnostica panel.

nodes.label: powerVal()
nodes.rationale: Normalizes instantaneous power to the powerUnit pref regardless of sensor unit; unrecognized units shown raw (an honest number in a strange unit beats a wrong one).

nodes.label: toWatts()
nodes.rationale: Split from powerVal (v1.6.0) so consumption derivation can combine sensors in a common unit.

nodes.label: deriveConsumption()
nodes.rationale: consumo = produzione + prelievo - immissione + scarica - carica; only when config.energy.consumption unset and all three grid/solar roles resolved, never a partial sum.

nodes.label: _sampleBatterySign()
nodes.rationale: Throttled (10s) 3-minute ring buffer of negative-derived-consumption samples, only when a battery term participated.

nodes.label: batterySignVerdict()
nodes.rationale: Suspect when >=5 samples and majority negative: a sustained wrong battery sign convention, not a blip.

nodes.label: plugStatus()
nodes.rationale: Three-tier plug state shared by room panel and on-now list so they never disagree.

nodes.label: call()
nodes.rationale: Single choke point for every service call: logs to the 20-entry _actionLog ring buffer and toasts failures; always resolves so fire-and-forget call sites stay safe.

nodes.label: _showActionToast()
nodes.rationale: Toast only on failure, one at a time, 6s auto-close.

nodes.label: runValve()
nodes.rationale: turn_on + setTimeout turn_off, plus a persisted deadline so the close does not depend on this one tab.

nodes.label: _checkIrrigationEnds()
nodes.rationale: Closes overdue valves from whichever client is open; _irrigationClosing guards double turn_off.

nodes.label: _bindAttr()
nodes.rationale: href/src/points are acted on by the browser HTML parser before React mounts, so they are set from a ref callback; idempotent because re-setting the same src restarts the load.

nodes.label: ENTITY_HIDDEN_SET()
nodes.rationale: Duck-typed Set (.has) since there is no fixed universe of entity ids.

nodes.label: SAVE_PREFS()
nodes.rationale: Persists immediately on every toggle, no separate save step.

nodes.label: _lpEntityId()
nodes.rationale: Long-press delegated at drawer level via data-entity-id; covers excluded so slider drags don't trigger the hide menu.

nodes.label: _panelLpMove()
nodes.rationale: Drag past 10px cancels the long-press.

nodes.label: SECTION_ORDER()
nodes.rationale: Per-user section order fused with the default via mergeSectionOrder so missing sections land next to their default neighbours.

nodes.label: ALL_ROOMS_RESULT()
nodes.rationale: Unfiltered by visibility so the settings panel can list hidden rooms to un-hide them.

nodes.label: diagEnergyInstant()
nodes.rationale: One row per instantaneous energy role with verdict ok/unconfigured/missing/unavailable plus unitWarn.

nodes.label: diagEnergyDaily()
nodes.rationale: Reads energyDiag captured by _resolveEnergyDaily, no re-resolution.

nodes.label: _settingsProblemTab()
nodes.rationale: Picks the settings tab to open on from the same diag verdicts; kept in sync with vmSettingsDiag's hasIssue.

nodes.label: roomSummary()
nodes.rationale: Uses plugStatus so 'in corso' means the same as the room panel's 'in funzione'.

nodes.label: vmSettingsDiag()
nodes.rationale: View-model method (v2): each page's renderVals calls it with a ctx of renderVals locals and binds the returned values in its template; before v2 each page carried its own copy of this block. Settings panel + Diagnostica rows, only computed while the drawer is open; Diagnostica computes even when discovery failed.

nodes.label: vmAlarm()
nodes.rationale: View-model method (v2): each page's renderVals calls it with a ctx of renderVals locals and binds the returned values in its template; before v2 each page carried its own copy of this block. Alarm buttons from supported_features bitmask; code_format gating opens the v1.9.0 PIN pad, code never stored or logged.

nodes.label: vmCameraDetail()
nodes.rationale: View-model method (v2): each page's renderVals calls it with a ctx of renderVals locals and binds the returned values in its template; before v2 each page carried its own copy of this block. Camera overlay: active layer, stable video ref, still URL, Connecting/Live badge (Live only once frames play), auto-close countdown.

nodes.label: vmEnergyRing()
nodes.rationale: View-model method (v2): each page's renderVals calls it with a ctx of renderVals locals and binds the returned values in its template; before v2 each page carried its own copy of this block. Double ring with autoconsumo derivation; colours follow the sage=sun / terracotta=grid role grammar; butt cap for zero-length segments.

nodes.label: vmHourlyStrip()
nodes.rationale: View-model method (v2): each page's renderVals calls it with a ctx of renderVals locals and binds the returned values in its template; before v2 each page carried its own copy of this block. 24 stacked hourly bars with the ring's role grammar; plain fixed-point % since locale decimal comma would break the style hole.

nodes.label: vmEnergyEmpty()
nodes.rationale: View-model method (v2): each page's renderVals calls it with a ctx of renderVals locals and binds the returned values in its template; before v2 each page carried its own copy of this block. Empty state case b: configured energy ids missing from HA shown by id.

nodes.label: vmLiveConsumption()
nodes.rationale: View-model method (v2): each page's renderVals calls it with a ctx of renderVals locals and binds the returned values in its template; before v2 each page carried its own copy of this block. Instantaneous house consumption, negative derived values hidden, battery sign sampling.

nodes.label: dash_neumo.html (desktop layout)
nodes.rationale: Desktop/wall-tablet layout (1280x800 preview). In v2 shared logic moved to casa-core.js; this page keeps template, initial state and a layout-specific renderVals().

nodes.label: Head script loading order
nodes.rationale: Order: vendored React UMD -> window.CASA_REACT_SOURCE -> document.write loader for ./casa-core.js?v= -> ./support.js. casa-core must define window.CasaCore before support.js and the x-dc script run; plain tags because import() is blocked under file:// (demo mode).

nodes.label: Vendored React 18.3.1 UMD scripts
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: React ships with the dashboard; support.js loadReactUmd() skips its CDN fetch when window.React/ReactDOM exist. Versioned file names instead of ?v= since react@18.3.1 content never changes. Missing vendor file falls back to CDN.

nodes.label: window.CASA_REACT_SOURCE
nodes.rationale: Records 'local' vs 'cdn' React source for Diagnostica -> Ambiente.

nodes.label: document.write loader for casa-core.js?v=
nodes.rationale: Reuses the page's own ?v= query param (same as bust()) so casa-core.js is cache-busted together with the page; document.write keeps it synchronous and before support.js.

nodes.label: Local @font-face rules (Caprasimo, Figtree)
nodes.rationale: Fonts served from ./vendor/fonts/ so the dashboard starts without internet (v1.9.0 offline assets).

nodes.label: sc-if / sc-for templating
nodes.rationale: Custom x-dc templating: sc-if with hint-placeholder-val, sc-for with hint-placeholder-count. style= property names are read from literal text at compile time; src/href/points bound via _bindAttr ref callbacks.

nodes.rationale: 1.9 was never published; its changes ship directly with 2.0 together with the 'major' single-core refactor.

nodes.label: Release 1.8.1
nodes.rationale: Born from an issue: irrigation buttons/climate row 'not responding' with zero console errors; nothing in the project ever read the outcome of tap -> service call.

nodes.label: Release 1.7.1
nodes.rationale: HA 2026.9.0 re-registered Matter devices as area-less duplicates; covers vanished from rooms with no message anywhere.

nodes.label: Release 1.5.1
nodes.rationale: A Shelly EM support case took six messages because every clue only reached console.info, invisible to companion-app/wall-tablet users.

nodes.label: Release 1.0.0
nodes.rationale: Validated end to end against a real Home Assistant installation, not just the demo dataset.

nodes.label: Shared logic core public/casa-core.js
nodes.rationale: Until 1.x desktop and mobile pages each held a full copy (85 of 86 methods identical, ~800 identical renderVals lines); every fix had to be done twice and comments had already diverged. Pages drop from 4580/3677 to 2643/2124 lines.

nodes.label: vm* view-model blocks (vmSettingsDiag, vmAlarm, vmCameraDetail, vmEnergyRing, vmHourlyStrip, vmEnergyEmpty, vmLiveConsumption)
nodes.rationale: Common renderVals() blocks extracted so each page's renderVals only assembles its own layout.
nodes.norm_label: vm* view-model blocks (vmsettingsdiag, vmalarm, vmcameradetail, vmenergyring, vmhourlystrip, vmenergyempty, vmliveconsumption)

nodes.label: Golden renderVals() before/after comparison (378 combinations)
nodes.rationale: Proves the refactor has no visible change: 9 demo scenarios x 2 layouts x 21 UI states compared identical; only intended diff is unused thumbColor field on mobile settings room rows.

nodes.label: version.json page cache-busting without restarting HA
nodes.rationale: panel.js reads version from version.json bypassing HA's 31-day /local/ cache and uses it as iframe ?v=, so module_url change and HA restart are only needed when panel.js itself changes.
nodes.norm_label: version.json page cache-busting without restarting ha

nodes.label: support.js treated as frozen dependency (hash-pinned)
nodes.rationale: Its source (dc-runtime/) is not in the repo, so it is not modified; a test pins its hash like vendor/ files.

nodes.label: 32 tests incl. core unit tests and no-method-redefinition test
nodes.rationale: Functions formerly inside pages were unreachable from Node; now W/kW normalization, derived consumption with battery sign, smart plugs, alarm PIN rules are unit tested, and a test forbids a page redefining a core method.
nodes.norm_label: 32 tests incl. core unit tests and no-method-redefinition test

nodes.label: Vendored React 18.3.1 runtime in public/vendor/
nodes.rationale: support.js downloaded React from unpkg on every load: offline HA, CDN-blocking networks or unpkg outages risked a blank tablet with no message. Files byte-identical (SHA-384 matches SRI); CDN kept as fallback if vendor/ missing.

nodes.label: Vendored Caprasimo/Figtree woff2 fonts
nodes.rationale: Zero requests outside the installation at startup; Figtree variable covers weight 500 previously browser-synthesized.

nodes.label: casa:hass-states-delta differential state push
nodes.rationale: Full hass.states copy every 600 ms (~175 KB, 666 entities) caused redraws for irrelevant entities. HA replaces entity objects on change, so reference comparison suffices: 30 s -> 4 messages, 13 entities, ~14 KB. Full snapshot resent every 5 min and on iframe reload as safety net.

nodes.label: Camera three-layer live view (hls.js / native HLS / fast stills)
nodes.rationale: 1.5.4: proxy-stream string substitution only served MJPEG and broke on RTSP/ONVIF/generic cameras. 1.9: unstable ref callback reset src every render (14 reloads/10 s), audio unmuted, stills never finished on slow cameras; now stable ref, muted, hls.js first, automatic fallback, 'Connessione...' badge.
nodes.norm_label: camera three-layer live view (hls.js / native hls / fast stills)

nodes.label: Stable per-stream ref callback (_bindAttr no-op on same value)
nodes.norm_label: stable per-stream ref callback (_bindattr no-op on same value)

nodes.label: Alarm PIN pad (code_format)
nodes.rationale: Code is never saved, logged in Ultime azioni, or included in Copia diagnostica; numeric keypad with 64 px keys or password field for alphanumeric codes.

nodes.label: Blueprint 'irrigation safety close'
nodes.rationale: Covers the 1.8.1 limit: with zero dashboards open the timed close never ran; closes valves (switch.* and valve.*) open beyond max time (20 min default) and on HA restart.

nodes.label: Vendored hls.js 1.7.4 (lazy-loaded)
nodes.rationale: 1.5.4 open question assumed it would be the first third-party runtime dependency; React already was, from CDN. With vendor/ and integrity test the decision became simple.

nodes.label: Node test suite + CI workflow (test.yml)
nodes.rationale: 20 dependency-free tests with node --test; CI on push and pull request.

nodes.label: call() single choke point for service calls
nodes.rationale: call() was silent fire-and-forget; now records ok/error/timeout and duration, toasts on error/timeout (not on success since state change shows it), never rejects so safe without await.
nodes.norm_label: call() single choke point for service calls

nodes.label: Diagnostica -> Ultime azioni ring buffer (last 20)
nodes.rationale: The section to paste into an issue from now on.

nodes.label: Timeout marked with .code='timeout'
nodes.rationale: Recognized by a code, not an Italian string to compare by hand.

nodes.label: Irrigation state from the valve entity
nodes.norm_label: irrigation state from the valve entity

nodes.label: Persisted irrigation close deadline (frontend/user_data)
nodes.rationale: Timed close no longer depends only on setTimeout in the tab that started it; checked every 15 s by any open client. Not enough with zero dashboards open (addressed by the blueprint).

nodes.label: Hourly 24-bar energy history strip
nodes.rationale: Same grammar as the ring, linear; from recorder/statistics_during_period; one call per view open; absent stats leave the card unchanged and the reason appears in Diagnostica.

nodes.label: Cover real position striped band
nodes.rationale: Pure reading, zero extra interactive surface; never a fake position when current_position is missing.

nodes.label: Matter duplicate-serial device warning
nodes.rationale: Pairs copies by serial number, not name, since name is exactly what diverges.

nodes.label: discoverRooms discard-reason logging (entità non mostrate)
nodes.rationale: Observability, not a new filter: discards were correct but invisible to users without a console; grouped by reason, sorted by actionability.

nodes.label: Home section order (sections.order)
nodes.rationale: Up/down arrows instead of drag to avoid collision with long-press-to-hide; unknown future sections fused next to default neighbours.

nodes.label: Derived house consumption
nodes.rationale: Removes the last manual template-sensor step; shows '—' instead of a partial sum; labeled 'calculated' everywhere.

nodes.label: Battery sign self-diagnosis with one-tap invert
nodes.rationale: Rolling window detects derived value negative more often than not; never shows a bare negative consumption.
nodes.norm_label: battery sign self-diagnosis with one-tap invert

nodes.label: Forceable demo scenarios (?demo&scenario=...)
nodes.rationale: Pure data patches to SEED/DEMO_CONFIG so a scenario runs exactly the code a real installation runs; partial/missing exercise fallbacks where past bugs lived unseen.

nodes.label: Alarm PIN awareness (gated no-op with note)
nodes.norm_label: alarm pin awareness (gated no-op with note)

nodes.label: Smart plug off/active/running via power sensor
nodes.rationale: Relay state answers 'energized', not 'appliance working'.
nodes.norm_label: smart plug off/active/running via power sensor

nodes.label: powerVal() W/kW/MW normalization
nodes.rationale: An honest number in a strange unit beats a wrong one in the expected unit.

nodes.label: Settings panel tabs (Stanze/Energia/Telecamere/Diagnostica)
nodes.rationale: Settings is where users go when something breaks: a tab with a real issue gets a dot and opening the panel jumps there.

nodes.label: Long-press timer cancelled on drag; cover row drops long-press-to-hide
nodes.norm_label: long-press timer cancelled on drag; cover row drops long-press-to-hide

nodes.label: Diagnostica panel (config path, energy roles, environment)
nodes.norm_label: diagnostica panel (config path, energy roles, environment)

nodes.label: Copia diagnostica button
nodes.rationale: A bug report becomes a paste instead of six messages; entity IDs never truncated.

nodes.label: Settings panel (visibility & order layer over config.js)
nodes.rationale: Requested by two Facebook-group reports; filters and reorders discovery output, composing layouts stays Lovelace's job.
nodes.norm_label: settings panel (visibility & order layer over config.js)

nodes.label: Per-user persistence via frontend/set_user_data with localStorage fallback
nodes.norm_label: per-user persistence via frontend/set_user_data with localstorage fallback

nodes.label: Room tiles sized to min-content; rooms.max 12
nodes.norm_label: room tiles sized to min-content; rooms.max 12

nodes.label: Energy role color grammar (sage = sun, terracotta = grid)
nodes.rationale: Ring and bars must agree; 1.4.5 chart had production/grid swapped vs the ring.
nodes.norm_label: energy role color grammar (sage = sun, terracotta = grid)

nodes.label: Third bar for energy fed to grid
nodes.norm_label: third bar for energy fed to grid

nodes.label: Flat grid source schema (stat_energy_from at top level)
nodes.norm_label: flat grid source schema (stat_energy_from at top level)

nodes.label: Deferred src/href/points binding after mount
nodes.rationale: Browser HTML parser fetches / before page JS runs, producing 404s for {{ m.icon }} placeholders.

nodes.label: Energy mapping from HA Energy dashboard (energy/get_prefs) + auto-discovery
nodes.rationale: 1.4.1 sums every entry per role (multiple arrays/contracts); real get_prefs failures logged with console.warn.
nodes.norm_label: energy mapping from ha energy dashboard (energy/get_prefs) + auto-discovery

nodes.label: Double concentric energy ring
nodes.rationale: Old ring compared production vs import, two numbers that never summed to a real quantity; now outer = consumption, inner = production, shared self-used segment.

nodes.label: panel_custom name: self-check
nodes.rationale: Mismatch produced a blank panel with nothing in the console; now console.error plus on-page message.

nodes.label: Custom element tag derived from deploy folder (<folder>-panel)
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded casa-panel produced a black panel for renamed folders; also avoids customElements.define collisions.
nodes.norm_label: custom element tag derived from deploy folder (<folder>-panel)

nodes.label: Config at config/www/live_dashboard_config.js (outside HACS folder)
nodes.rationale: A HACS update overwrites its own folder; config placed next to the dashboard would be wiped.

nodes.label: Exclude any config-referenced entity from generic room lists
nodes.rationale: One schema-agnostic exclusion instead of a hardcoded field list.
nodes.norm_label: exclude any config-referenced entity from generic room lists

nodes.label: ASSET_VERSION ?v= reused by every loadScript()
nodes.rationale: Scripts loaded by the page had no cache-bust, so a stale discovery.js survived deploys and HA restarts.

nodes.label: [data-sel="true"] !important override
nodes.rationale: Inline styles always beat stylesheet rules regardless of specificity; mobile mode buttons had zero visible difference.

nodes.label: Verify presentation changes by looking (screenshot/DOM), suspect markup first
nodes.rationale: Code can be correct and the pixel wrong or invisible.
nodes.norm_label: verify presentation changes by looking (screenshot/dom), suspect markup first

nodes.label: Constraint 1: literal style= attribute (property:{{ value }})
nodes.rationale: CSS property names are read from literal attribute text at compile time; a hole holding 'width:13px' compiles to an empty style silently.

nodes.label: Constraint 2: dynamic src/href/points via ref callback after mount
nodes.rationale: The browser HTML parser loads them before JS runs.
nodes.norm_label: constraint 2: dynamic src/href/points via ref callback after mount

nodes.label: Constraint 3: window.CASA_CONFIG global, not a module
nodes.rationale: import() is blocked under file:// where demo mode runs.
nodes.norm_label: constraint 3: window.casa_config global, not a module

nodes.label: Constraint 4: panel_custom tag derived from folder (live_dashboard-panel under HACS)
nodes.rationale: Getting it wrong produced a silent black screen.
nodes.norm_label: constraint 4: panel_custom tag derived from folder (live_dashboard-panel under hacs)

nodes.label: Constraint 5: flat HA energy schema for grid source
nodes.norm_label: constraint 5: flat ha energy schema for grid source

nodes.label: Constraint 6: never the same expression in two sc-if with opposite hint-placeholder-val
nodes.rationale: Both branches rendered in the live DOM (v1.8.1, Ultime azioni); negated branch must get its own name from renderVals() (noDiagActionRows).
nodes.norm_label: constraint 6: never the same expression in two sc-if with opposite hint-placeholder-val

nodes.label: Dove va il codice (v2)
nodes.rationale: Logic lives once in casa-core.js; pages contain only layout.

nodes.label: casa-core.js loaded in <head> before support.js, classic script with page ?v=
nodes.rationale: Runtime evaluates the component class right after React; classic script rather than ES module because of constraint 3.
nodes.norm_label: casa-core.js loaded in <head> before support.js, classic script with page ?v=

nodes.label: Test fails if a page redefines a base method
nodes.norm_label: test fails if a page redefines a base method

nodes.label: Density before 'fits in one screen' (44 px targets, 10 px text)
nodes.rationale: 1280x800 no-scroll constraint retired in v1.4.9: with 12 rooms and 4 cameras inner scroll is accepted; never compress typography, touch targets or spacing.
nodes.norm_label: density before 'fits in one screen' (44 px targets, 10 px text)

nodes.label: Energy role colors: --sage self-consumption, --acc import, --feed export
nodes.rationale: Ring and bars must share the same grammar; divergence is a bug.
nodes.norm_label: energy role colors: --sage self-consumption, --acc import, --feed export

nodes.label: Session orientation: graphify wiki/GRAPH_REPORT, graphify query, latest CHANGELOG entry
nodes.norm_label: session orientation: graphify wiki/graph_report, graphify query, latest changelog entry

nodes.label: Regenerate graphify and commit graphify-out/ with code changes
nodes.rationale: graphify-out is the repo map; if it lags it describes a version that no longer exists.
nodes.norm_label: regenerate graphify and commit graphify-out/ with code changes

nodes.label: Node count is not a regression signal; verify coverage by symbol grep
nodes.rationale: Extraction is semantic and distributed (492 -> 571 -> 615 -> 513 across growing releases).
nodes.norm_label: node count is not a regression signal; verify coverage by symbol grep

nodes.label: No graphify post-commit hook
nodes.rationale: Hook does an AST-only rebuild after commit and overwrites the semantic graph with a poorer one (254 vs 298 nodes).

nodes.label: Release rules (user config outside HACS folder, single VERSION in panel.js, v-prefixed tags)
nodes.norm_label: release rules (user config outside hacs folder, single version in panel.js, v-prefixed tags)

nodes.label: A tag is not a release: push tag + gh release create with CHANGELOG notes
nodes.rationale: HACS shows releases, not tags; a tag without release reaches nobody. Verify live_dashboard.zip asset.
nodes.norm_label: a tag is not a release: push tag + gh release create with changelog notes

nodes.label: Diagnostics must be visible in dashboard, not only console
nodes.rationale: Most users are on companion app or wall tablets where console.log doesn't exist.
nodes.norm_label: diagnostics must be visible in dashboard, not only console
